ValidationRule.description: Customer number must be numbers and between 10 and 15 digits long.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, AND( OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General_Inquiry_CMOS'), NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_Customer_Number__c)), ISCHANGED(IDR_Customer_Number__c) ), NOT(REGEX(IDR_Customer_Number__c, "^[0-9]{10,15}$")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer number must be numbers and between 10 and 15 digits long.
